resources.string: Short guides. Open any guide to replay it.
Start with the contacts on your phone. Your Ticklr network stays on this device.
Choose individual people with the contact picker, or import all contacts Ticklr can access.
Find your imported people in Network. Open a profile to create a tickle or add someone to a group.
Bring professional connections into Ticklr using your LinkedIn connections CSV.
Request your connections data from LinkedIn and save the downloaded CSV on your phone. The import screen has the export instructions.
Choose your connections CSV. After import, find your connections in Network and add any missing contact details.
Open a profile and tap Create a tickle to set a reminder to reconnect.
Pick a rhythm or a special date
Choose a frequency and starting date. For a birthday, choose Birthday and set the date; the tickle repeats annually.
Add a note, then save. Find your reminder on the profile and in the Tickle tab.
Keep family, friends, and work connections together in groups.
Open a profile, find Groups, and choose Add to Group. Select a group to add the person. A person can belong to more than one group.
Use the plus button in Groups to create your own circle, then choose its members.
